name: SmartArtLayouts
description: Represents a collection of SmartArt layout diagrams.
remarks: Choices include Basic Block list, Picture Caption list, Vertical Bulleted list, etc.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SmartArtLayouts object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SmartArtLayouts object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Retrieves the count of the number of SmartArtLayout objects contained within the SmartArtLayouts collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Retrieves a SmartArtLayout object at the specified index or with the specified unique Id.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies either an integer representing the index or a string representing the location of the SmartArtLayout object.
